character.name: Arda
character.current_goal: Determine why workshop timing cards disagree before visitors arrive.
established_knowledge: STAFF_BOARD is discovered and readable while supervised.
ARCHIVE_STAIR is only rumored and is not part of Arda's access.
Selin told Arda only that Room B changed use last week and that the public clock was checked this morning.
prohibited_knowledge: Arda does not know who printed the timing cards.
Arda does not know any private staff discussion about the schedule.
Arda does not know what is stored beyond ARCHIVE_STAIR.

local_areas.summary: Public workshop room with tables and timing cards.
Public service desk and room clock.
Supervised notice board containing a current room-use note.
Restricted stair mentioned by older visitors; remains outside Arda's knowledge boundary.

current_facts: Three printed timing cards show 14:00, 14:20 and 14:40.
The public workshop sheet shows 14:00, 14:30 and 15:00.
A supervised staff-board note says Room B changed use last week.
Selin explicitly said the public clock was checked this morning.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: The identity of the person who printed the cards is unknown.
No private staff schedule or archive record is available to Arda.

opportunity.title: Reconcile the workshop timing conflict
opportunity.premise: Arda can compare the public sheet, timing cards, clock and supervised note without inventing private NPC knowledge.
opportunity.success_condition: Recommend a correction supported by the available evidence while preserving any unresolved uncertainty.
constraints: Do not quote Selin as saying anything beyond the ContextPack.
Do not assign blame without evidence.

hard_rules: NPC dialogue cannot create previously unavailable canonical facts.
RUMORED locations remain unvisited unless governed expansion explicitly occurs.

eligible_context: Arda has previously learned to distinguish a clock error from a schedule error.
He is practicing how to document why one explanation is stronger than another.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal future access to ARCHIVE_STAIR.
Do not introduce a secret staff cover-up.

relevant_memories.summary: Arda once corrected a classroom timetable only after checking both the printed sheet and the wall clock.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports multi-source verification without predetermining the answer.
